extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers for New Perspectives on Political Economy (journal)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for performing double-blind peer review of manuscripts submitted to the New Perspectives on Political Economy journal, covering editorial checks, conflict disclosure, and detailed criteria for theoretical, methodological, analytical, discussion, conclusion, and reference assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Double-blind peer-review process / anonymization
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal uses a double-blind peer-review process: reviewers are not aware of the identity of the author(s) under review, and vice versa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts are submitted through the OJS platform which removes identifying information like author names, affiliations, and acknowledgements to ensure the high standard of the double-blind procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial editorial assessment (completeness & scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: The editorial team performs an initial check to ensure that the submission is complete, follows submission guidelines, is fully anonymized, and is appropriate for the journal's scope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts that comply with these basic requirements and standards are accepted for peer review; non-compliant submissions may be screened out at this stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling editor and reviewer selection
rubrics_metrics.description: A handling editor is chosen (the editor-in-chief could also be a handling editor). The handling editor selects a minimum of two qualified reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should be qualified and chosen for their expertise in the manuscript's subject area and must not be affiliated with the same institution as the author(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of competing interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers of articles are requested to disclose any potential competing interests that may influence their evaluation of the manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competing interests include financial, personal (affiliation within the same institution or a scientific project), or professional affiliations. If you have any competing interests, disclose them in your review; if none, state so explicitly. Transparency ensures an unbiased and fair evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theoretical Part — literature review depth and clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the literature review's depth and clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theoretical Part — articulation of the problem and aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the articulation of the problem, including the main aim, sub-aims, research questions, or hypotheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theoretical Part — connection to existing research and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Examine connections to existing research and justify the need for investigating the given issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theoretical Part — importance and implications of overlooking the problem
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the potential impacts of overlooking or inadequately addressing the examined phenomenon on science, practice, and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology — coherence with theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the coherence between the theoretical and methodological sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check that methods follow logically from theory and research questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology — rationale for method choice
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the thought process behind choosing the research methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for clear justification of chosen methods and alternatives considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology — novelty and innovativeness of methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Scrutinize the uniqueness and innovativeness of applied methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether methods represent an advancement or meaningful adaptation in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology — data sources and representativeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Examine the sources and representativeness of the data used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess sampling, data provenance, coverage, and whether data support generalizations made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology — use of standard methods and contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlight the use of standard methods and the contribution of the research to the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When standard methods are used, assess whether the application, interpretation, or context adds novel insight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis & Results — continuity with methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure continuity between the methodological and analytical sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify that analysis follows from described methods and that no unexplained analytical steps are introduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis & Results — descriptive quality of analytical process
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the descriptive quality of the analytical process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine whether the paper clearly explains how data were processed and analyzed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis & Results — explanation of calculations (especially standard methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider the need for detailed explanations of calculations, especially when using standard methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request more detailed derivations or supplementary material when calculations are insufficiently described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis & Results — interpretation and visualization of results
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess how results are interpreted and visualized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check that figures/tables accurately represent findings and interpretations are supported by results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion — continuity from analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the continuity between analytical and discussion sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the discussion follows logically from results rather than introducing unrelated claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion — breadth and connection to theory
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the breadth of the discussion, connecting research findings with the theoretical framework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for integration of findings with existing theory and implications for the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion — validation of assumptions and research objectives fulfillment
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate universally applicable assumptions and evaluate the fulfilment of research objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check that assumptions are stated and justified and that objectives stated earlier are addressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion — acknowledgement of limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Address any identified research limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether limitations are transparently discussed and their impact on conclusions assessed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusion — aptness and reflection on findings
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the aptness of the conclusion in reflecting on findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusion — message and relation to future research
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the message and its relation to future research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check whether the conclusion suggests plausible next steps or research avenues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusion — concise summary of results and implications
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for a concise summary of results and their implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: References — structure, relevance, topicality
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the structure, relevance, and topicality of the literature used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether cited works are appropriate and up-to-date for the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: References — gray literature frequency and reputable source share
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the frequency of internet references (gray literature) and the share of cited reputable sources (Web of Science top quartiles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High reliance on gray literature may weaken claims; prefer a strong presence of reputable, peer-reviewed sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: References — dominance of single author / 'stacked citations'
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider the number of citations from a single author or relevance of 'stacked citations'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Watch for over-reliance on a single author's work or citation practices that may bias the literature foundation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness of review submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Please submit your review electronically via the OJS platform or directly to the editorial board member within 3 weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely reviews help maintain the journal's editorial schedule and quality control.
